title: Every email sign-in, sign-up and password reset carries an invisible bot check that Supabase verifies

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-11-26 (project thread: Restore password login alongside magic link and Google): Yes, invisible check

detail: FOUND 2026-11-26: the email doors (magic link, signup link, password sign-in, sign-up, reset) reach Supabase's auth API, which the public key opens to any script; our LIVE-043 and SEC-045 limits cover only our forms. SHIPPED: Cloudflare Turnstile (invisible, explicit render, refresh on expiry) in components/frequency/auth/bot-check.tsx on every form that sends (sign-in link and password, new-account create, create account, forgot, Settings password link, the join induction, the feature funnels and the beta join page, which remounts the widget per send because a token works once). app/sign-in/actions.ts passes it as captchaToken to signInWithOtp, signInWithPassword, signUp and resetPasswordForEmail, answers a missing or refused token with the `bot` line, and stays off while NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY is blank. CSP admits challenges.cloudflare.com (script-src, frame-src) in next.config.ts and the nonce policy. OWNER STEPS (docs/RUNBOOKS.md, Invisible bot check): Cloudflare widget, then the site key in Vercel, then the Supabase captcha toggle with the secret key, never the other way round. The native app (mobile/, parked) sends no token, so re-check before it ships. ADR-1981.

verify.note: Fails while any email door skips the token, any sending form lacks the widget, the CSP blocks Turnstile, or the switch and its runbook are missing.
